name: pov
description: Point-of-view skill with three modes. Default (shape): zoom out, decompose, design the ideal state from intent and first principles, shown as pictures, without what exists; then, by complexity, a perspective pass for naming or competing views. Interactive: the original turn-manager protocol, unfold → synthesize → reduce → conclude, one turn per reply. Panel: many independent agents. Use for "pov", "zoom out", "decompose", "first principles", "ideal state", naming, decision synthesis and strategic alignment.
